name: Digital core and special core analysis
aliases: Digital core and special core analysis
applications: scenarios hard to test in the lab
principle: Cores are imaged by whole-core CT (0.5 mm slices), micro-CT and FIB-SEM, and the 3D images are used to compute porosity, permeability, capillary pressure and relative permeability in simulations. Schlumberger reports that analysis taking weeks or months can finish in hours or days.

source.note: GeoExpro, Inside the Rock (Schlumberger digital rock article, 2015)

limitations: Results are validated against lab tests
Turnaround claim (weeks or months down to hours or days) has no benchmark
